The implementation correctly makes all tests pass, which is the core requirement. However, the docstring needs to be updated.

The colon-handling logic (capitalizing small words after colons) exists specifically to satisfy the `test_subtitle_after_colon` test and contradicts the docstring, which states small words are only capitalized as "first or last word of text." 

Since the tests encode the spec agreed with the editorial team, the implementation is correct. But the docstring should be updated to document the colon-handling behavior:

"...the word is written in lowercase -- unless it is the first or the last word of `text`, or immediately follows a colon, in which case its first character is uppercased."

This ensures code and documentation consistency for future maintainers.
